parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring or membrane mechanism.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the keyboard, made of durable ABS plastic that holds all keys and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the key switches and electronic circuits.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Tilt Leg
parts.Basic_description: A small foldable leg under the keyboard made of ABS plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It adjusts the typing angle by elevating the rear of the keyboard.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or folds in and out to change the keyboard’s tilt.

parts.name: Indicator Light (Other)
parts.Basic_description: A small transparent or translucent light indicator made of polycarbonate.
parts.Functional_description: It displays the status of functions such as Caps Lock, Num Lock, or power.
parts.Movement_description: It does not move; it emits light when activated electronically.
